title: Trace base change from the local diagonal section to the affine counit
statement: Let P be a finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions], Y a Noetherian scheme, aY:Y to Spec k a locally finite-type quasi-compact structure morphism, and d a natural number. Let p:A^d_Y to Y be the smooth ordered affine projection of relative dimension d [def-amb-affine-trace-tower], V an affine open of Y, and H affine diagonal geometry for p,aY,d,V [lem-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement]. Put B=p inverse V, h=p restricted to V, g=pr1:B times_V B to B, and s=diagonal h. For any normalized finite twist transport t and P1 family D, write S for the actual section trace over B [def-pur-restricted-affine-diagonal-section-trace], alpha:C(g,s) isomorphic to nu_B omega_h for the prescribed diagonal comparison, and rho for the prescribed target-open exchange. Let L be pro-etale pullback along B inclusion, nu be site comparison on A^d_Y, tau the canonical finite Tate pullback along B inclusion, c=L(nu(unitChange p)), and m_Y the actual ordinary affine counit mate over Y [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data]. Then S alpha rho inverse c = tau inverse L(nu(m_Y)). No DNC comparison, normal-section beta or beta normalization occurs in this equation.

proof.text: Convert diagonalAffineMate followed by inverse unitChange to the monoidal-unit towerAdjoint by naturality of the exceptional adjunction Hom equivalence. Apply affineCoordinateCounit_baseChange. The coefficient core equation, together with the proved coefficient_comp helper in OrderedTateExactOpenComposition, identifies its source comparison with normalized ordered Tate transport. This proves base change for the actual affine mate, with its prescribed coefficients.

Use both projection equations of restrictedAffineDiagonalCoordinates. Paste the canonical tower square with the coordinate-isomorphism square, and compare with the self-product square pasted with the target-open square. The proved dualizing_base_comp helper in SectionExceptionalFibreCoherence identifies the two composites. Normalize coefficients using coefficient_comp and naturality of the inverse-image compositor.

Pull the equation along the diagonal. The derived inverse-image identity law cancels the identity-base compositor in sectionBaseChange. Expand diagonalComparedRestriction, cancel the exceptional base-change map with its inverse, and use naturality of the section compositor and orderedTateSectionPullback. This gives the ordinary etale restriction equation.

Apply the site-comparison functor. Expand alpha and cancel the sourceComparison isomorphism. Naturality of comparisonPull identifies the remaining comparison with rho. Uniqueness of normalized finite twist transport identifies the chosen transport with the canonical transport in tate. Cancel rho and the coefficient-unit conversion to obtain the stated equation, without changing any target or definition.

lean.statement:
theorem restrictedAffineDiagonalTraceBaseChange (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (d : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (affineTraceProjection Y d)]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (H : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
      (hT : IsUnit (P.diagonalExponent : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t T hT) :
    let ν := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) (affineTraceTower Y d)).mapDerivedCategory
    OrientationCounit.restrictedAffineDiagonalSectionTrace P Y d aY V H t D ≫
        (OrientationRefinement.alpha P (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V H).hom ≫
        (OrientationRefinement.rho P (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V H).inv ≫
        ((OrientationRefinement.pull P (affineTraceProjection Y d ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).mapIso
          (ν.mapIso (OrientationCounit.unitChange P (affineTraceProjection Y d)))).hom =
      (OrientationRefinement.tate P (affineTraceProjection Y d ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι
        (affineTraceProjection Y d ≫ aY) d).inv ≫
        (OrientationRefinement.pull P (affineTraceProjection Y d ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).map
          (ν.map (P.diagonalAffineMate t D Y (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aY) d))
